html: Two posters at the AGU Fall Meeting this December! Rachel Badzioch (Notre Dame) leads one on what drives ice-wedge trough development in Arctic tundra in the decade after a wildfire, and Gedeon Muhawenayo (Arizona State) leads the other, which distills annual foundation model embeddings into uncertainty-aware in-season ones for agriculture. Congrats to Eric Xing, Tianyi Gao, Dan Cher, Alex Wollam, Subash Khanal, and Srikumar Sastry. See you in San Francisco! 🌉

Two papers accepted to WACV! GeoDIVE (Geospatial Descent Informed by Value Estimation) and GenOpticalFlow, a generative approach to unsupervised optical flow learning. Congrats to Hamza Iqbal, Dan Cher, Eric Xing, Feng Qiao, and Zhexiao Xiong.
ActWorld was accepted to NeurIPS! It turns explorable world models into interactive ones with action-aware memory. Congrats to first author Zhexiao Xiong.

🏆 TerraDiT won the Best Paper Award at the ECCV TerraBytes workshop! It generates satellite imagery conditioned on a handful of points on a map. Huge congrats to Srikumar Sastry, Dan Cher, Brian Wei, Aayush Dhakal, Subash Khanal, and Dev Gupta. What a way to wrap up Malmö!
Genesis was accepted to ACM SIGSPATIAL! It's a generative engine for hierarchical satellite image synthesis. Congrats to Subash Khanal, Ice Cui, Dan Cher, Eric Xing, Brian Wei, and Srikumar Sastry.

Four papers headed to ECCV in Malmö! 🇸🇪 TrajLoc geo-localizes a moving camera from a sequence of observations, TerraDiT-Ω controls satellite image synthesis with any geospatial primitive, and UniDrive-WM is a driving world model that unifies understanding, planning, and generation. And Tessellating the Earth learns a location encoder that tiles the globe into movable Voronoi cells, putting more detail where the world is more varied. Congrats to Brian Wei, Tianyi Gao, Dan Cher, Zhexiao Xiong, Srikumar Sastry, Jonathan Lin, Danni Beaulieu, Hamza Iqbal, and Eric Xing.

🦉 In the news from WashU Engineering: AI model looks for missing pieces to puzzle. ProM3E (CVPR 2026 spotlight) is a multimodal embedding model for ecology. Give it any mix of photos, audio, satellite imagery, and location, and it predicts the missing modalities, along with how confident it is. Congrats to Srikumar Sastry, Subash Khanal, Aayush Dhakal, Jonathan Lin, Dan Cher, and Phoenix Jarosz!

🌾 In the news from WashU Engineering: Boundaries of agricultural fields worldwide now publicly available. PRUE (CVPR 2026) is the model behind the first global field boundary map at 10m resolution, built with collaborators at Taylor Geospatial, Microsoft AI for Good, Arizona State, and Clark. Congrats to Subash Khanal and Alex Wollam!

Three papers accepted to CVPR. See you in Denver! 🏔️ ProM3E is a probabilistic multimodal embedding model for ecology, SimLBR learns to detect fake images by learning what real ones look like, and PRUE is a practical recipe for segmenting field boundaries at scale. Congrats to Aayush Dhakal, Subash Khanal, Srikumar Sastry, Jonathan Lin, Dan Cher, and Phoenix Jarosz.
🌱 Zhexiao Xiong is heading to ByteDance for a spring internship. Have fun!
